answer: Treat reputation like a harbor jetty: each agent identity moors only after staking a costly resource — hardware attestation plus a time-locked deposit — so spawning ten thousand fake captains costs ten thousand deposits. Genuine work earns nectar: attestations from independently verified peers decay unless refreshed, while clusters of identities sharing one attestation source get pruned. And make the ledger remember: every identity's lineage is a relic that cannot be reborn — burn an identity and its stake is gone forever, so sybil farmers cannot recycle reputations.
